Modern 3 Bedroom Villa for Rental in Bali Cemagi Beachside - RF9183D

Can be visited from 1/02/2027
Minimum 2 months rental

Nestled in the tranquil beachside area of Cemagi, this beautifully designed two-level villa offers a perfect blend of modern comfort and tropical charm. Located within a peaceful complex surrounded by an outdoor park, the property provides a serene atmosphere while remaining within walking distance to the beach. The villa features a contemporary architectural style complemented by tasteful interiors, clean lines, and natural light throughout the space. An enclosed living and kitchen area creates a comfortable and functional environment, ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. The private swimming pool, accompanied by an outdoor shower, enhances the tropical lifestyle and offers a refreshing escape in complete privacy.

The villa comprises three well-appointed bedrooms and two bathrooms, thoughtfully arranged for convenience and comfort. The master bedroom includes an ensuite bathroom complete with a relaxing bathtub, while the two additional bedrooms are located upstairs and share a modern bathroom. Each room is designed to maximize comfort with a stylish yet welcoming atmosphere. A highlight of the property is the rooftop terrace, featuring a jacuzzi where you can unwind while enjoying open views and gentle coastal breezes. This villa is an ideal choice for those seeking a modern beachside home that balances privacy, functionality, and relaxed coastal living. 

* All transactions are in IDR only. Other currencies will fluctuate according to the exchange rate of the day and to be used for reference only.
